# Data sessions

- [slides session 1](./session-01-slides.qmd)

# Agenda

| Time | Section | Focus |
|----|----|----|
| 0–10 min | **Welcome & Icebreaker** | What is data? Where do we see SQL? Icebreaker Q: *“When did you last use Excel?”* |
| 10–20 min | **Why SQL? Why not Excel?** | Talk through strengths/weaknesses of SQL vs Excel using relatable examples |
| 20–30 min | **Intro to Relational Databases** | Tables, rows, columns, schema - use visual or draw analogy to spreadsheets |
| 30–40 min | **Live Demo: Set up and Naming Conventions** | Lowercase, plurals, underscores vs camelCase. Create empty tables (Sales or Movies) |
| 40–70 min | **Hands-On Lab (Core SQL): CRUD + AGG** | See detailed breakdown below |
| 70–85 min | **Live Queries: Filter, Sort, Aggregate** | Interactive Q&A: “What happens if…?”, small queries as a group |
| 85–90 min | **Cliffhanger & Tease for Session 2** | Sneak peek: JOINs, building dashboards, writing better SQL |
